summary: List Specification Sets for a Project
description: This endpoint returns a paginated list of Specification sets for a Project.

parameters.name: specification_area_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the specification area.

parameters.name: with_none_set
parameters.description: When true on the first page, includes a synthetic `none` set when sections exist without a specification set.

parameters.name: is_recycle_bin
parameters.description: When true, evaluates the `none` set option against deleted specification sections.

data.description: List of specifications sets for current project

deletable.description: True if set does not have any related revisions or uploads

403.description: User does not have right permissions
